description: Defines the RsaBlinder class for RSA blinding operations, including methods for creating, blinding, unblinding, and verifying signatures, with dependencies on cryptographic utilities and protobufs.

classes.name: RsaBlinder
classes.description: A class for RSA blinding operations, including creating, blinding messages, unblinding signatures, and verification, with support for optional public metadata.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new RsaBlinder instance with the given RSA public key and optional public metadata.

methods.name: Blind
methods.description: Blinds a message using RSA public key parameters and optional metadata.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies an unblinded signature against the input message.
